question_bank.stem: Why is diffusion introduced after the GAN discussion?

options.text: It models the data distribution with one denoising model rather than a minimax game.
It models the discriminator labels with two networks rather than one classifier.
It models prompt attacks with a hidden trigger rather than a training patch.
It models output filtering with safety checks rather than image corruption.

question_bank.explanation: Diffusion avoids the coupled adversarial game and trains a single model on noising and denoising.

distractor_rationales.C: Mixes prompt injection and backdoors with diffusion.
distractor_rationales.D: Confuses defense filtering with generative modeling.

question_bank.stem: What happens in the forward diffusion process described in the lecture?

options.text: Start with x0 and progressively add noise until the image becomes unrecognizable.
Start with xT and progressively remove labels until the image becomes classified.
Start with z and progressively train a discriminator until the image becomes real.
Start with a prompt and progressively insert triggers until the image becomes poisoned.

question_bank.explanation: Forward diffusion takes a clean image and adds noise step by step until it reaches a highly noisy state.

distractor_rationales.B: Describes reverse denoising and classification vocabulary incorrectly.
distractor_rationales.C: Confuses diffusion with GAN generator training.
distractor_rationales.D: Confuses diffusion with prompt and poisoning attacks.

question_bank.stem: In the simplified recurrence, what kind of noise is added at each step?

options.text: Gaussian noise sampled at each time step.
Binary class noise copied from the discriminator.
Prompt noise copied from the user template.
Patch noise printed from the detector output.

question_bank.stem: Why does the forward process store or define the cumulative noise?

options.text: The reverse model can later learn to predict the noise that was added.
The discriminator can later learn to label the noise as real or fake.
The prompt template can later learn to hide the noise in user text.
The patch optimizer can later learn to print the noise as a trigger.

question_bank.explanation: Forward noising creates the supervised target for the reverse denoising task: predict the cumulative noise.

distractor_rationales.B: Moves the target to GAN discrimination.
